template.name: Keltner Channel Golden Cross
template.entry_long: close > ema(close,{p0}) + {p0} * atr(high,low,close,{p1}) and ema(close,{p2}) > ema(close,50)
template.notes: Keltner is approximated by EMA(20) plus/minus 2 ATR(14), and EMA(20)>EMA(50) is the golden-cross confirmation; all lengths are fallbacks because none are documented. ATR-based stop and target cannot be encoded as fixed percentages.
